ja.region_unusual_note: この場所・この季節には、ふつうはいない種です（BirdNET に入っている、どの場所・季節にどの種がいそうかの一覧による）。AI のまちがいのこともあるので、声をよく聞いて確かめてください。

ja.custom_model_date: この種用に作ったAI（{month}/{day}作成）
ja.custom_models_note: この種用に作った AI は、人が答えた 5 秒の音を材料にして作りました。この種の声の材料は、「声はあったか」の画面で「この種の声だ」とした音、「この種用のAIを育てる」で「声あり」と答えた音、「AI の答えを確かめる」で「聞こえる」と答えた音です。ほかの音の材料は、「声なし」や「聞こえない」と答えた音です。AI を作ったあとに答えた音は、材料に入っていません。AI の 5 秒ごとの音と位置がずれている音も、材料に入っていません。そのため、材料の数は、「人が聞いて確かめた」の音の数と違うことがあります。この AI の確認と集計も、5 秒ごとの音で行います。
ja.presence_files: 種ごとの「人が聞いて確かめた」記録（声ありの音の数、見つからなかった記録）
ja.all_scores: AI が「声あり」と数えなかった音も含む、調べたすべての音の AI の点数{windows}
ja.evidence_files: 音声ファイルと、AI の例の音・人が聞いて確かめた音・正しかった割合の確認で答えた音との対応
ja.validation_files: 正しかった割合の確認の、音の選び方・答え・境目・結果の記録
ja.custom_model_files: この種用に作ったAI・材料の記録
ja.files_note: このフォルダの index.html を開くと、本文・図・表と音声をオフラインで見られます。ほかの人に渡すときは ZIP 全体を渡し、受け取った人は展開してから開いてください。
ja.evidence_note: AI の例の音は、AI ごとに AI の点数が高い上位 5 音です。人が聞いて確かめた音ではありません。人が聞いて確かめた音と、正しかった割合の確認で答えた音は、元の音の長さのまま別に保存しています。
ja.methods_note: 検出は各 AI が一度に調べる長さの音を使い、境目と等しい AI の点数の音も「声あり」と数えます。元の予測・回答は書き換えず、人の確認で決めた境目（確認が済んでいないときは、はじめから決まっている境目）を、調べたすべての音に当てています。確かめても境目を決められなかった AI の検出は数えません。新しい確認では、期間内のすべての音を AI の点数の順位で6組に分けます。はじめから決まっている境目以上の検出が最上位の組（上位3.125%）より少なければ、最上位の組を検出した音そのものにし、残りを元の下位5組の幅の比で分けます。各組から10音を無作為に選び、10音以下ならすべて選びます。追加の音はありません。以前に作った確認は元の順位による6組と、必要に応じた最大18音の追加を保ちます。各確認の抽出方式と回答は保存記録に含まれます。声が入っていた音の割合と音の数は組ごとのベータ分布（事前分布0.1）から、AI の点数の境目・正しい検出の割合・見つけた割合・AUPRCは AI の点数のロジットに対するロジスティック曲線から求めています。
ja.region_source: 「この場所・この季節には、ふつうはいない種」という注意は、BirdNET 2.4 の、場所と季節から出る種を予測する AI で付けています。地点の緯度・経度について、期間内に録音のある週（BirdNETの週。1年を48週に分ける）ごとに出現確率0.03以上の種を求め、どの週にも入らない種に注意を付けます。注意はすべてのAIの結果に付けるだけで、結果を除くことはしません。
ja.precision_note: 正しい検出の割合（精度）は、AI が「声あり」と数えた音のうち、本当に声があった割合です。見つけた割合は、声があった音のうち、AI が「声あり」と数えた割合です。見つけた割合は範囲が広いので、年や種の比較には使わないでください。AUPRCは、声のある音を AI がどれだけ点数の上位に並べられたかを示し、1に近いほどよいことを示します。「おそらく〜の間」は 90% の範囲です。
ja.validation_scope: 結果は、対象期間のすべての音{windows}についての推定です。「判断できない」と答えた音は計算に使いません。声が入っていた音が全体の1%未満と推定された種では、珍しい種のため、見つけた割合を示しません。
ja.human_reference: 利用者が確かめて答えた結果をもとにした評価です。人の判定そのものが常に正しいことや、別の地点・期間でも同じ性能になることを保証する値ではありません。

ja.figure_caution: 声が見つからなくても、いなかったとは言えません。

en.title: Wildlife calls in these recordings
en.copied: Copied. Paste into Word or another editor.
en.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the report text and copy it manually.
en.copy_hint: To use this in your own report, copy the text and tables, and save the figures you need.
en.region_unusual_note: This species is not usually found at this place in this season (according to BirdNET's built-in list of which species are expected where and when). The AI may be wrong, so listen carefully to check the call.
en.rare_recall: Too few sounds contained the call to estimate how many were missed
en.partial_coverage: These results cover only part of the recordings. They do not describe the whole recording collection.
en.custom_models_note: An AI made for one species learned from 5-second sounds that people answered. Its examples of the call are sounds marked “This is its call” on the “Is it here?” page, answered “Call heard” on the “Grow an AI for this species” page, or answered “Heard” in “Check the AI's answers”. Its examples of other sounds are those answered “No call” or “Not heard”. Sounds answered after the AI was made are not included. Sounds that do not line up with the AI's 5-second sounds are not included either. So these numbers can differ from the number of sounds confirmed by listening. This AI is also checked and counted on 5-second sounds.
en.presence_files: "Confirmed by listening" records per species (number of sounds with the call, and "call not found" records)
en.all_scores: AI scores for every sound examined, including those the AI did not count as containing the call{windows}
en.evidence_files: Audio files and how they link to AI examples, sounds confirmed by listening and accuracy-check answers
en.validation_files: Accuracy checks: how sounds were chosen, answers, cut-offs and results
en.custom_model_files: AIs made for one species and the sounds they learned from
en.files_note: Open index.html in this folder to read the text, figures and tables and play the audio offline. To share it, send the whole ZIP; the recipient should extract it before opening.
en.evidence_note: AI examples are the five sounds with the highest AI scores per result, not human confirmations. Listening evidence and check answers are saved separately at their original sound lengths.
en.methods_note: Detection uses each AI's input sound length and counts AI scores equal to the cut-off as containing the call. Original predictions and answers remain unchanged. The AI score cut-off decided by checking, or the documented default cut-off while the check is not finished, is applied to all eligible sounds. Detections of an AI whose check could not decide a cut-off are not counted. New checks divide all sounds in the period into six groups by AI score rank. If detections at the AI's default cut-off are fewer than the top group (top 3.125%), the top group becomes exactly those detections, and the remaining sounds are split in the relative widths of the original five lower groups. Ten sounds are drawn at random per group; groups of ten or fewer are fully sampled. No extra sounds are added. Older checks retain their original six rank groups and optional extension of up to 18 sounds. Each check's sampling method and answers are saved. Call density and sound counts come from per-group Beta distributions (prior 0.1); the AI score cut-off, precision, recall and AUPRC come from a logistic curve over the logit of the AI score.
en.region_source: The “not usually found at this place in this season” note comes from BirdNET 2.4's range AI, which predicts the species expected at a place and season. For the site's latitude and longitude, it lists the species with an occurrence probability of 0.03 or higher in each BirdNET week (the year is split into 48 weeks) that has recordings in the period. Species missing from all of those weeks get the note. The note is added to results from every AI; no results are removed.
en.precision_note: Precision is the share of sounds the AI counted as containing the call that really did. Recall is the share of sounds with the call that the AI counted. Recall ranges are wide; do not use them to compare years or species. AUPRC shows how well the AI ranks sounds with the call above those without; closer to 1 is better. “Probably between” ranges are 90% ranges.
en.validation_scope: Results estimate all sounds in the period{windows}. “Cannot tell” answers are not used. When fewer than 1% of sounds are estimated to contain the call, the species is too rare here to estimate missed calls, so recall is not reported.
en.human_reference: These estimates are based on what users checked and answered. They do not establish that human judgements are always correct or that performance transfers to another site or period.

en.reading_windows: The AI cuts the recordings into short sounds ({windows}) and gives each one an "AI score" (0 to 1; higher means the AI finds it more like this species' call; each AI has its own scale). Sounds scoring at or above a chosen value (the cut-off) are counted as "call present". Counts are numbers of sounds, not numbers of calls or animals.

en.reading_figure: The circular figure works like a clock: one full turn is one day, with midnight at the top. Each day is one ring, from the first day in the innermost ring to the last day in the outermost ring.
en.legend_red: Darker red: the AI counted a larger share of that hour as "call present"
en.legend_note: A dot marks an hour the AI did not examine; a dot on a colour means only part of that hour was examined. Grey or dotted hours do not mean there were no calls.

en.limits_title: What these recordings cannot tell you
en.limits_text: Not finding a call does not mean the species was absent. These recordings alone cannot tell you what happened when nothing was being recorded, how many animals there were, whether they were breeding, where a call came from, or whether conservation work in the area is succeeding.
